desk.period: First half of fiscal year to March 2027 (six months to 30 Sep 2026)
desk.headline: H1 revenue up 10% to ¥1.67trn; net income more than triples to ¥856bn on Kioxia-linked gains; full-year forecast left at ¥530bn
results: Revenue from continuing operations rose 10% to ¥1.67trn, helped by investment gains, service income and goods and property sales.
Net income more than tripled to ¥856bn, mainly from ¥796bn of equity-method income tied to Toshiba's gains on Kioxia shares — a non-cash, share-price-driven item.
Stripping out the Kioxia gains, adjusted net income was about ¥318bn, which sets the dividend.
Sale of ORIX Bank completed on 3 Aug, booking a ¥124bn pre-tax gain in discontinued operations; total assets fell 13%.
Infrastructure profit fell on the absence of last year's Greenko and Ormat gains; USA & Europe profit rose on private-equity gains.

guidance.summary: ORIX kept its full-year net income forecast of ¥530bn (up 18.5%), even though first-half profit is already above it, saying the Kioxia impact cannot yet be reliably estimated. The interim dividend of ¥113.56 is above the ¥107.27 it had forecast.
